name: gstnoticesupport-unified
description: Deployment entry point that boots client/ (Next.js) and server/ (Express) in one process for single-domain hosting. See server.js.

scripts.build:server: cd server && npm install --include=dev && npx prisma generate && npm run build
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
